ValidationRule.description: Blocks field changes after Status is SEALED.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status__c)) = "SEALED", OR( ISCHANGED(Snapshot_Id__c), ISCHANGED(Deployment_Id__c), ISCHANGED(Source_Org_Id__c), ISCHANGED(Destination_Org_Id__c), ISCHANGED(Source_Branch__c), ISCHANGED(Destination_Branch__c), ISCHANGED(Created_At__c), ISCHANGED(Completed_At__c), ISCHANGED(Sealed_At__c), ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(Schema_Version__c), ISCHANGED(Snapshot_Version__c), ISCHANGED(Overall_Integrity_Hash__c), ISCHANGED(Rollback_Eligible__c), ISCHANGED(Capture_Failure_Reason__c), ISCHANGED(Member_Count__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: SEALED snapshots are immutable and cannot be changed.
